clips.title: The story
paras: Darsok Swiftdagger sends you from the northern Barrens into Stonetalon Mountains with news for his old friend, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil. Serena Bloodfeather has fallen, and Darsok wants Jin'Zil to know.

Darsok Swiftdagger sends you into Stonetalon Mountains after Serena Bloodfeather falls. The Witchwing and Bloodfeather broods came from the rugged ridges northwest of the northern Barrens, not the scrublands. Now that you have defeated Serena, Darsok asks you to carry the news of her death to his old acquaintance, Witch Doctor Jin'Zil. Jin'Zil lives at the troll settlement of Malaka'jin, in the dangerous mountain peaks.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You've done so well for me, friend. You're a regular lucky rabbit's foot and there's something I want you to see.

The harpies are not from around the Barrens. They come from a place called Stonetalon, far to the northwest of here. Though it is probably a dangerous place for you, I need this letter delivered to an old friend of mine who lives there, a witch doctor by the name of Jin'Zil.
He'll be happy to know that Serena Bloodfeather is dead, and I think you'll find Stonetalon an interesting place.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You seem a shady character. You have something for me to see?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ahh, a letter from Darsok. I have not heard from him in many years.
So the last of the Bloodfeathers are dead, eh? That is good news, I can remember when my friend Rokhan went with that crazy mok'nathal to kill her older sister. Ah, to be young again, like you.
